heic-to 1.6.6 (CSP build, unmodified)

Used by assets/cropper.js to convert HEIC/HEIF photos (iPhone) to JPEG in the browser.
Loaded on demand with import(), only when someone picks a HEIC/HEIF file in a browser that cannot decode it natively.

Source:  https://www.npmjs.com/package/heic-to  (file: dist/csp/heic-to.min.js)
Licence: LGPL-3.0, see LICENSE in this folder.
Updating: replace heic-to.min.js with the same file from a newer release and update the version above.
